_comments: bc-aidp-next-golive#207, the tester's third comment: 'Deal Status Type' -> 'Status' and
THE ROW THAT MATTERS IS THE VIRTUAL NAME FIELD, NOT THE FOREIGN KEY, and getting that wrong is
silent. mj-form-field resolves an FK's label through RelatedEntityNameFieldMap BEFORE the field's
own DisplayName (form-field.component.ts: it returns nameField.DisplayNameOrName and only falls
through to FieldInfo.DisplayNameOrName afterwards), and the baseline maps DealStatusTypeID ->
rows applies cleanly, asserts successfully, and changes nothing anyone sees.
Measured against the database before writing this: DealStatusType reads 'Deal Status Type' and
DealStatusTypeID reads 'Deal Status Type ID'. The tester's 'Current label' column says 'Deal Status
Type' -- the virtual field -- which is the tell that these are the rows they meant.
AutoUpdateDisplayName goes to 0 so the label is a deliberate choice rather than something derived
from the column name if the column is ever renamed. CodeGen does not otherwise revert DisplayName:
spUpdateExistingEntityFieldsFromSchema never writes it (unlike Description), and
updateEntityFieldDisplayNameWhereNull is gated on the value being NULL.
